critique.evidence: Frame delivery is stable: tablet/mobile average about 16.67ms with 16.8ms worst frames and 0 long-frame ratio; desktop has 19.31ms average, 33.4ms worst, and 0 long-frame ratio. However, the measured interaction lacks a convincing progression: desktop standard mid already equals end, while tablet/mobile mid values are nearly settled. Reduced motion makes the interaction settle immediately, but still reports 1 active animation and 46 transition-bearing elements, so suppression is not fully proven.
critique.fix: Give standard mode a clearly measurable start–mid–end progression with a refined duration/easing curve. Under prefers-reduced-motion, disable all nonessential animations and transitions so activeAnimationCount reaches 0 while preserving the immediate final state.
